label: Philips Hue Bridge smart lighting hub
description: The Hue Bridge is the Zigbee hub for Hue bulbs, sensors and cameras (up to 50 lights and 12 accessories), exposing a local HTTPS/REST API and Matter bridging to the LAN. It is wired-only on the network side: a single 100M Ethernet port to the router (Hue's setup guide requires a free LAN port and the bundled Ethernet cable) and no WiFi radio at all - the 2.4 GHz link it runs is Zigbee to the bulbs, which is not an IP interface.
